            "total_entries": 0,

        }

        "avg_length": avg_length,
        "most_common_word": most_common_word,
        "most_common_count": count
    }

        part3 = "3. Most common word: N/A"

    entries = get_input()
    results = analyze_entries(entries)
    output_summary(results)
